finding.summary: Arc workspace navigation and the right-side Files/Terminal tablist use the same global flow-workspace-tabs class with separate component-specific rules.

references.fact: Arc navigation outer div uses flow-workspace-tabs.
Global selector adds gap .5rem, border-bottom, padding .4rem .75rem; descendant buttons get min sizes, radius and padding.
Right-side workspace tablist uses identical class.
Global selector sets flex:1 and overflow-x:auto for right-side tablist; these also match Arc top bar.
App statically imports Arc layout.css; WorkspacePanels imports its own workspace.css at line6.

finding.assessment: Selectors overlap regardless of which bundle is loaded first. Property effect and layout severity need mounted observation; no screenshot or computed-style proof claimed. Plugin-local style activation should not restyle unrelated host navigation.
